set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWYS7H6C4XP4GGERQXXMH98S. Define EdgeTopology, directed and undirected edge values, rectangular cells, EdgeSpace, EdgeVector, and EdgeVectorizer. Make edge ordering explicit instead of hiding Ariadne conn_set upper-triangle/off-diagonal conventions in ad hoc code. Acceptance: undirected vectorization uses a documented upper-triangle order, directed vectorization uses documented off-diagonal order, rectangular vectorization is column-major when matching Ariadne conn_rect_set, and round-trip/law tests pass on JVM and JS.
set.title: Connectivity topology, edge spaces, and vectorization laws
